purpose: Narrow upstream evidence for llama.cpp server model-config option naming and path behavior; Saga intentionally implements a much smaller, safer subset.

sources.notes: Pinned documentation describes --models-preset as router configuration and documents model, alias, ctx-size, cache-type-k/v. This supports key naming only; Saga deliberately uses a single-profile contract.

upstream.hash_status: SHA-256 computed from the exact raw pinned README URL with shasum -a 256.

adaptation.contract: One [model] section and one profile per Saga process; no model catalog, named selector, wildcard, router, or hot reload.
adaptation.implementation: No upstream parser or implementation code copied. Unknown keys are rejected; server/security keys remain TOML-only; no shell/environment expansion is supported.
adaptation.path_policy: Saga resolves relative model artifacts against the INI file and explicitly handles Windows drive/UNC/root-relative cases.
